checks: Five heroes; legal half-elf Alchemist 3, HP24, AC15, prepared4+subclass2, cantrips2, held tool focus, two infusions and matching racial language/skill choices.
Twelve UI renames survive reload without resource changes.
Cancelled d6 causes no changes; rest healing elixir consumes one flask, heals 2+3+INT3, returns the empty flask.
Chosen resilience spends one slot; +1 AC and spent slot survive reload.
Held alchemist supplies satisfy casting focus; Cure Wounds heals 3+INT3 and spends exactly one slot.
Preparation stays active until long rest; rest commits four choices, replenishes slots and expires the elixir AC bonus.
Removing starter rations remains permanent after reload; the migration never refills them.
Abilities and inventory fit 390px and 320px mobile viewports.
Fire Bolt spends the action, no slot, uses entered d20/d10, and the live encounter survives reload.
Detect Magic asks for scene facts, uses one slot and maintains concentration; inspecting an aura costs the combat action and no extra slot.

Grease asks for the area, all creatures and physical saves; spends one slot, knocks the failed target prone, and refuses to advance on a cancelled repeat save. The next entered save advances once without another slot.
The public catalog finds the ordinary 100 gp Identify pearl with its priced-component card; it is never granted to Liora for free.
Archive names find the same unique Lightning Lure and Tasha’s Caustic Brew cards in the 351-spell catalog without changing the character.

Fire Bolt asks for an object’s name, AC, HP, flammability, held status, range and clear path; entered d20=15 and d10=7 reduce HP15 to8 and ignite it. Damage and fire survive reload; confirmed extinguishing survives a second reload without changing character resources.
